name: Jericho Commons
summary: Jericho Commons is a fully-leased, Whole Foods-anchored community center serving one of Long Island's most affluent markets in North Central Nassau County. With exceptional highway access and trade area household incomes exceeding $217,000, this 130,296 square foot center has established itself as a premier retail destination.
demographics: Jericho Commons serves an exceptionally affluent trade area, with the surrounding community ranked among the top 50 most affluent small cities in the nation. The 1-mile radius shows an average household income of $217,972 and median household income of $161,951, with the 3-mile and 5-mile rings maintaining similarly strong demographics above $200,000 average household income. The center attracts educated, high-income families and professionals from North Central Nassau County who prioritize quality and convenience in their shopping experience. With a daytime population exceeding residential population, the area benefits from significant commercial activity and commuter traffic from the nearby Long Island Expressway and Northern State Parkway.
description: Jericho Commons is a premier community shopping center located in one of Long Island's most affluent communities, strategically positioned at 429 North Broadway in Jericho, New York. Anchored by Whole Foods Market, this 130,296 square foot center serves the prosperous North Central Nassau County market, which ranks among the top 50 most affluent small cities in America according to AdvisorSmith. The center's exceptional location provides unparalleled convenience with direct access to both the Long Island Expressway and Northern State Parkway, making it a natural destination for the area's discerning shoppers. The trade area demographics are remarkable, with average household incomes exceeding $217,000 within a one-mile radius and maintaining over $200,000 within three miles, reflecting the sophisticated consumer base that frequents this property. Currently fully leased with a waitlist for future availability, Jericho Commons has established itself as a thriving retail destination where quality retailers excel in serving this high-income, educated community.
